rationale: The reviewer steadfastly insists the boat requirement ruins the visit and defends the one-star rating with specific petty grievances (drive time, seasickness, ferry lines) and no self-aware mitigation. The lone weak concession "Statue itself? Fine, I guess." is minimal and doesn't undercut the overall wrongness.
quote: I drove FOUR HOURS to see the Statue of Liberty, only to find out you can't just walk up to it.
